notes: Historical years are the last 3 completed Darden fiscal years ending in late May: FY2023 (5/28/2023), FY2024 (5/26/2024), FY2025 (5/25/2025). ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2024/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2024-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-And-Provides-Fiscal-2025-Outlook/default.aspx))
EBIT is proxied as Operating income from the consolidated statements; D&A is proxied as Depreciation and amortization from the consolidated statements.

Capex is proxied as Purchases of land, buildings and equipment from the cash flow statements (excluding purchases of capitalized software and changes in other assets). ([darden.com](https://www.darden.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/DRI%20Q4%20FY25%20Earnings%20Release%20-%20Final.pdf))

NWC is defined as Total current assets minus Total current liabilities from the consolidated balance sheet (can be negative for restaurant operators due to accounts payable and unearned revenue). ([darden.com](https://www.darden.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/DRI%20Q4%20FY25%20Earnings%20Release%20-%20Final.pdf))

Base-case forecast driver values (post-FY2026) are sober, steady-state assumptions derived primarily from recent ratios, with revenue growth decelerating after the management-provided FY2026 outlook. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))

WACC and terminal growth are not directly disclosed in the provided filing excerpts; they are assumed for DCF purposes (WACC=0.085, terminal growth=0.02). Adjust to your pipeline’s standard capital structure methodology if needed.

NOL balance uses the 10-K deferred tax asset line item for 'Net operating loss, credit and charitable contribution carryforwards' (tax-effected). Gross NOL and an explicit annual utilization percent are not separately disclosed here, so nol_utilization_pct is set to null. ([fintel.io](https://fintel.io/doc/sec-darden-restaurants-inc-940944-10k-2025-july-18-20287-8239))

catalysts: Outperformance vs fiscal 2026 guidance (total sales growth and same-restaurant sales) could support faster cash flow generation. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))

Sustained EBIT margin stability or upside from labor/commodity cost management would improve valuation multiples and DCF returns. ([darden.com](https://www.darden.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/DRI%20Q4%20FY25%20Earnings%20Release%20-%20Final.pdf))

Capital spending execution within the $700 million to $750 million range could reinforce unit economics and long-term growth. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))
company_overview: Darden Restaurants is a multi-brand full-service restaurant operator with a portfolio including Olive Garden and LongHorn Steakhouse (and additional brands via acquisitions). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/940944/000119312525172298/d56753dars.pdf?utm_source=openai))

The company reports results on a consolidated basis with fiscal years ending in late May (e.g., fiscal 2025 ended 5/25/2025). ([darden.com](https://www.darden.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/DRI%20Q4%20FY25%20Earnings%20Release%20-%20Final.pdf))

Strategy emphasizes same-restaurant sales growth, unit growth through new restaurant openings, and disciplined capital spending. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))
current_context: Fiscal 2025 total sales increased 6.0% to $12.1 billion; consolidated same-restaurant sales grew 2.0%, with reported diluted net earnings per share from continuing operations of $8.88. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))

Fiscal 2026 outlook provided: total sales growth of 7% to 8% (including ~2% from a 53rd week) and same-restaurant sales growth of 2% to 3.5%, with total capital spending of $700 million to $750 million and an effective tax rate of ~13%. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))

Latest FY financial base for the model: fiscal 2025 sales of $12,076.7 million, operating income of $1,362.3 million, and depreciation & amortization of $516.1 million. ([darden.com](https://www.darden.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/DRI%20Q4%20FY25%20Earnings%20Release%20-%20Final.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth anchors to management’s fiscal 2026 total sales growth outlook, followed by gradual deceleration toward a mature restaurant-growth profile. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))

EBIT margin is modeled to expand modestly from fiscal 2025 levels, consistent with a stable cost structure and gradual operating leverage. ([darden.com](https://www.darden.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/DRI%20Q4%20FY25%20Earnings%20Release%20-%20Final.pdf))

Reinvestment intensity (capex as a % of sales) is held near recent levels to support ongoing unit growth and remodel/capex needs. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))

Model working-capital behavior uses negative NWC as a percent of sales (driven by accounts payable and unearned revenue), consistent with the company’s historical balance sheet pattern. ([darden.com](https://www.darden.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/DRI%20Q4%20FY25%20Earnings%20Release%20-%20Final.pdf))
key_risks: Consumer demand softness and/or higher-than-expected labor and commodity inflation could pressure same-restaurant sales and margins. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))

Operational disruption and integration execution risk related to acquired brands could affect costs and growth cadence. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))

Higher discount rates (WACC) or lower terminal growth assumptions would reduce intrinsic value sensitivity. ([investor.darden.com](https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2025/Darden-Restaurants-Reports-Fiscal-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results-Increases-Quarterly-Dividend-Authorizes-New-1-Billion-Share-Repurchase-Program-And-Provides-Fiscal-2026-Outlook/default.aspx))

Comps are included using restaurant peer EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA plus forward P/E where available; StockAnalysis multiples are used as proxies for EV/NTM measures. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/qsr/statistics/))
